command: set -euo pipefail; echo HEAD=$(git rev-parse HEAD); echo TOP=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel); echo '--- root ---'; find . -maxdepth 1 -mindepth 1 -printf '%f\n' | sort | head -80; echo '--- sparse ---'; git sparse-checkout list 2>&1 || true; echo '--- tree-private ---'; git ls-tree -r HEAD -- research_entity/private agentZero/tresor | sed -E 's/^[0-9]+ blob [0-9a-f]+[[:space:]]+//'
